design_changes: Replaced original single massing block with mapped 17-vertex structural outline centered in local coordinates.
Added four-story brick shell and parapet, roof deck, long central skylight strip and low-profile rooftop equipment that stays within the 14.8 m tagged roof envelope.

Added taller, fewer facade windows, pale floor bands, masonry/stone textures, a projecting brick atrium pavilion with an elliptical raised crown, tall screened glazing, front canopy, entry lettering and basic entrance furniture.
Added schematic atrium balconies, stair flights, reception, seating and feature-wall volumes; these are illustrative only because a verified interior plan was unavailable.
Added a separate preview camera/light rig outside the exported asset collection.
model.portable_materials: Procedural materials only; no external images, linked libraries or external asset dependencies.

validation.result: Blender 5.2.3 opened saved asset in a separate process; expected scene/collection present, 12 collection objects, 10672 evaluated mesh vertices, no external libraries. Evaluated vertical extent is 14.81 m; structural outline agrees with OSM bounding coordinates within 0.000002 m. Main roof and rooftop equipment now remain within the 14.8 m source-height envelope to rounding.
remaining_uncertainty: GIS and OSM wall/roof outlines disagree by several meters; selected OSM roof outline aligns visually with the aerial and gives an area closer to official 147000 square feet.

Exact floor heights and total surveyed height are unavailable; story elevations are schematic and OSM's 14.8 m value is unsurveyed. The evaluated roof/mechanical envelope reaches 14.81 m, a rounding-scale 0.01 m above the tagged height; equipment heights are approximate.

Exact interior layout, atrium opening dimensions, finish materials, and secondary facade details are illustrative rather than verified from dimensioned plans. An inward raycast confirms the sample center atrium opening is clear; complete interior visibility still needs visual review.
Preview lighting is a presentation setup and does not represent site illumination.
